artifact_observations.reasoning: The text labels on the click wheel (MENU, PREV, NEXT) are illegible and distorted. The word 'MENU' appears to have extra characters or melting, and other labels are indistinct blobs rather than sharp typography.
The central button on the right device lacks the distinct separation and shadow depth seen on the left device, appearing slightly fused or flat compared to the surrounding ring.
The boundary where the two iPods meet is slightly soft and ambiguous, lacking the crisp hard-surface definition expected from rigid plastic/metal objects.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the left iPod's click wheel. AI generators often fail at rendering small, curved text accurately.
